```{r}

# Combine the 'raw' and 'new' FHB phenotype files, then keep only the
# accessions on your list (matching on accession name OR synonym).

library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)   # install.packages(c("readxl","readr","dplyr","stringr","tidyr","writexl")) if needed

# ---- 1. EDIT THESE to match your files and column names ---------------------
raw_file      <- "raw_NUWWSN.csv"
new_file      <- "CUHB_raw.csv"
list_file     <- "samplename_request.xlsx"   # change to read_csv below if it's a .csv
raw_name_col  <- "germplasmName"   # accession name column in the raw/new files
raw_syn_col   <- "germplasmSynonyms"     # synonym column in the raw file
list_name_col <- "FullSampleName"   # accession column in your list file
year_col      <- "studyYear"        # used to sort earliest -> latest
loc_col       <- "locationName"    # used to flag duplicates between files
syn_delim     <- "[,]"        # how multiple synonyms are separated in one cell
na_values     <- c("", "NA", ".", "-", "*", "n/a")   # placeholders meaning "missing"
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---- 2. Read both files as text (so nothing is lost) -------------------------
raw_a <- read_csv(raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
raw_b <- read_csv(new_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# Columns that differ between the files -- check these printouts
message("Only in raw: ", paste(setdiff(names(raw_a), names(raw_b)), collapse = ", "))
message("Only in new: ", paste(setdiff(names(raw_b), names(raw_a)), collapse = ", "))

# If the same column is spelled differently in 'new', rename it to match raw:
# raw_b <- rename(raw_b, Year = YEAR)      # new_name = old_name

# ---- 3. Combine into one dataset called 'raw' --------------------------------
raw <- bind_rows(
  mutate(raw_a, source_file = "raw"),
  mutate(raw_b, source_file = "new")
) %>%
  type_convert(na = na_values)

# ---- 4. Read your accession list --------------------------------------------
keep <- read_excel(list_file)
# keep <- read_csv(list_file, show_col_types = FALSE)   # use this instead if it's a .csv

# ---- 5. Filter to the accessions on your list -------------------------------
clean <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  str_remove_all(x, "[\\s_-]")
}

raw <- raw %>% mutate(.row = row_number())

# If 'new' has no synonym column, make sure one exists so the code below works
if (!raw_syn_col %in% names(raw)) raw[[raw_syn_col]] <- NA_character_

raw_names <- raw %>%
  transmute(.row,
            name = as.character(.data[[raw_name_col]]),
            syn  = as.character(.data[[raw_syn_col]])) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(name, syn), names_to = "matched_via", values_to = "id") %>%
  separate_longer_delim(id, delim = regex(syn_delim)) %>%
  mutate(key = clean(id)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key), key != "", key != "NA")

list_keys <- keep %>%
  transmute(list_name = as.character(.data[[list_name_col]]),
            key = clean(list_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key), key != "") %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

matches <- raw_names %>%
  inner_join(list_keys, by = "key") %>%
  arrange(.row, matched_via) %>%            # prefer main name over synonym
  group_by(.row) %>%
  summarise(n_list_hits = n_distinct(list_name),
            list_name   = first(list_name),
            matched_via = first(matched_via),
            .groups = "drop")

filtered <- raw %>%
  inner_join(matches, by = ".row") %>%
  relocate(list_name, matched_via, source_file, .after = all_of(raw_name_col)) %>%
  arrange(.data[[year_col]]) %>%
  select(-.row)

# ---- 6. Checks ---------------------------------------------------------------
not_found <- list_keys %>%
  anti_join(raw_names, by = "key") %>%
  select(list_name)

ambiguous <- filtered %>% filter(n_list_hits > 1)

# Same accession + year + location present in BOTH files
dups <- filtered %>%
  group_by(list_name, .data[[year_col]], .data[[loc_col]]) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(source_file) > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(list_name, .data[[year_col]], .data[[loc_col]])

# ---- 7. Save -----------------------------------------------------------------
write_xlsx(list(filtered  = select(filtered, -n_list_hits),
                not_found = not_found,
                ambiguous = ambiguous,
                dups      = dups),
           "combined_filtered.xlsx")

message(nrow(raw), " combined rows -> ", nrow(filtered), " kept\n",
        n_distinct(filtered$list_name), " of ", nrow(list_keys),
        " list accessions found\n",
        nrow(not_found), " not found | ",
        nrow(ambiguous), " ambiguous | ",
        nrow(dups), " rows in both files")
```
